article.headline: Grizzlies play the Jazz, aim for 4th straight win
article.description: Memphis Grizzlies (3-0, fourth in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-2, 12th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Grizzlies play the Jazz, aim for 4th straight win
article.linkText: Grizzlies play the Jazz, aim for 4th straight win
article.story: Memphis Grizzlies (3-0, fourth in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-2, 12th in the Western Conference) Salt Lake City; Monday, 9 p.m. EDT LINE: Jazz -1.5; over/under is 238.5 BOTTOM LINE: Memphis is looking to keep its three-game win streak alive when the Grizzlies take on Utah. Utah went 22-60 overall, 12-40 in Western Conference play and 14-27 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Jazz averaged 29.6 assists per game on 42.5 made field goals last season. Memphis finished 25-57 overall and 19-33 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Grizzlies averaged 114.7 points per game last season, 18.0 from the free-throw line and 41.7 from beyond the arc. The two teams match up for the second time this season. The Grizzlies defeated the Jazz 123-103 in their last meeting on Oct. 22. Ty Jerome led the Grizzlies with 45 points, and Keyonte George led the Jazz with 22 points. INJURIES: Jazz: Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot). Grizzlies: Zach Edey: out (). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
